master_host.description: Hostname or IP address of the MooseFS Master server.

master_port.description: TCP port on which the Master server listens for chunkserver connections.

chunks_password.description: Password used to authenticate the chunkserver to the Master. Must match the contents of /etc/mfs/mfschunkserver.passwd.

data_path.description: List of directory paths where chunk data is stored. Must exist and be writable by the mfs user.

items.description: Absolute path to a chunk storage directory.

worker_threads.description: Number of worker threads to handle chunk operations (I/O, verification, etc.).

max_open_files.description: Maximum number of open files (file descriptors). Set to 0 to use system limits.

chunks_max_count.description: Maximum number of chunks allowed per data directory. Set to 0 for no limit.

chunks_size_limit.description: Maximum size (in bytes) of a single chunk file. Set to 0 for system default (usually 64 MiB).

verify_chunks_on_read.description: If true, chunkserver verifies checksums during disk reads to detect corruption.

delete_empty_dirs.description: If true, empty chunk directories are deleted automatically during cleanup.

bind_address.description: IP address to bind the chunkserver’s network service to.

io_schedulers.description: List of disk I/O scheduler mappings for data paths. Each item specifies a path and its I/O scheduler (e.g., 'none', 'deadline', 'cfq').

path.description: Absolute path to a chunk data directory.

scheduler.description: I/O scheduler to apply (e.g., 'none', 'deadline', 'cfq'). 'none' uses the default.

reserved_space.description: Bytes of free space reserved per data directory (chunks won’t be stored if free space ≤ reserved).
